question: The ______ sultanate was ruled by the Sharqi dynasty.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jaunpur.**__

__
 
• The **Jaunpur sultanate **was ruled by the Sharqi dynasty.
 
• Malik-ul-Sharq__ was the founder of the Sharqi Dynasty.
 
• Malik-ul-Sharq made Jaunpur his capital and established his reign from **Etawah to Bengal and Vindhyachal **to Nepal.
 
• The founder of the Sharqi Dynasty, Malik-ul-Sharq, died in 1398 A.D.
